_about: Which printings (finishes) BBM made of each Reiwa-era sumo set, from BBM's official product articles and checklist PDFs. apply-finishes.mjs writes the `parallels` into cards.json; everything else is notes. Ranges are card numbers in cards.json (they match the official checklists 1:1). confidence: confirmed = stated per card in the official checklist; stated = stated in the official article, no per-card list needed.

_finishes.kira: キラカード: sparkle-printed version of the same card (same number and photo), 1 per pack. effect: sparkle.
_finishes.kira-heart: 2026 S2 only: rarer kira parallel with a heart pattern (ハート柄). effect: sparkle.
_finishes.kira-star: 2026 S2 only: rarer kira parallel with a star pattern (星柄). effect: sparkle.

20s1.notes: No parallels. Regular-card frame colour varies by rank, which BBM does not treat as a parallel. 8 autographs.

21s2.notes: Takumi: no parallels, and no finish marks on the checklist. 8 autographs.

24s2.notes: Hibiki: no parallels, and no finish marks on the checklist. Insert TREASURE: 5 cards, 25 copies each. 12 autographs.

25s1.notes: First set with kira: makuuchi regulars and the 縁起物 subset. Insert 至宝 SH1-SH7: 50 copies each on gold-foil paper, plus a 1-of-1 light-purple foil (薄紫箔) parallel of each — the first 1-of-1 in the sumo line. 12 autographs.

25s2.notes: Nagomi: kira for all regulars and the Smile! subset. Insert TREASURE TSM1-TSM7: 25 copies each. 13 autographs, Hoshoryu also as a 30-copy photo variation. Card 71 「二子山 雅高」 is oyakata Futagoyama (ex-Miyabiyama).

26s1.notes: Kira uses a cherry-blossom pattern. Inserts 巨星 KY1-KY2 and 明星 MY1-MY5: 50 copies each in gold foil on gold paper, plus a 1-of-1 purple foil (パープル箔) parallel of each. 14 autographs, Onosato also as a 30-copy variation.

26s2.notes: Sato: kira in three tiers (regular, heart, star) for regulars, 同郷の絆, 兄弟！ and Another Scene. Cards 01-08 (komusubi and up) also have a secret version with a different photo — a photo variation, not a finish, so not in cards.json. Insert TREASURE TSM1-TSM8: 25 copies each. 14 autographs and 4 combo autographs (first in the series).
